items.en: Choose how course materials sync when you connect Canvas or set up Semestra, before the first sync. Materials left after turning the sync off can be removed in one step.
items.zh: 连接 Canvas 或初次设置时，可在首次同步前选好课程资料的同步方式；关闭同步后留下的资料可一次移除。

items.en: AI tools connected over MCP now use Sem's skills and working rules, so they follow the same steps as Sem.
items.zh: 通过 MCP 连接的 AI 工具现在可以使用 Sem 的技能和工作规则，按与 Sem 相同的步骤完成任务。

items.en: Long file, folder and course names no longer push dialogs wider than the window; they are shortened or wrapped instead.
items.zh: 较长的文件、文件夹和课程名称不再把对话框撑出窗口，而是省略或换行显示。

items.en: Links in sticky notes open with a single click; start writing with the note's edit button or a double-click.
items.zh: 便签中的链接单击即可打开；点编辑按钮或双击文字即可开始书写。

items.en: Lists in settings, such as the import history, now fit the window: long names are shortened instead of pushing the last columns out of view.
items.zh: 设置中的列表（如导入历史）不再超出窗口，较长的名称会省略显示，末尾的列不再被遮住。

items.en: Signing in again in the same browser no longer leaves an extra entry under signed-in devices.
items.zh: 在同一浏览器重新登录时，登录设备里不再多出一条旧记录。
